decks.notes: This deck focuses on fast, aggressive play by utilizing efficient creatures and disruptive spells to control the board and pressure opponents. The main strategy is to use early game threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to disrupt the opponent's hand and gain advantage, while also utilizing removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate to deal with any threats. The addition of cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional value and versatility to keep the pressure on and maintain board control.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and played using spells like Chord of Calling. The creatures in the deck have synergies that allow for combo plays, generating value through sacrifice and recursion effects. By utilizing cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide, the deck can control the board and outvalue opponents. The mana base is designed to support the color requirements of the deck while also providing utility lands for additional benefits.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with various abilities to create synergies and generate value, ultimately leading to a powerful combo finish. By tutoring for specific creatures with cards like Chord of Calling and Collected Company, the deck can quickly assemble a board state that overwhelms the opponent. The creatures in the deck interact with each other in unique ways, allowing for different paths to victory. With the ability to generate tokens, sacrifice creatures for value, and create a resilient board presence, the deck aims to outvalue and outpace the opponent.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand and board while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief. The deck also aims to control the board with removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push, while utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Undying Evil and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional ways to protect and maximize the value of the deck's creatures.

The main idea of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively disrupt the opponent?s hand while applying pressure with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief. Utilizing disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate, along with powerful cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, the deck aims to control the game early on and close out the match before the opponent can stabilize. With a focus on fast and proactive plays, this deck is designed to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and disruption.

This deck focuses on control elements in order to slow down the opponent's strategy and take over the game in the late stages. It utilizes a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful creatures like Teferi, Time Raveler and Omnath, Locus of Creation to control the board and generate card advantage. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and cards like Endurance and Solitude give the deck additional protection and versatility in different matchups. The companion Keruga, the Macrosage provides additional card draw and ensures the deck can maintain its advantage in longer games.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays with efficient removal and hand disruption that aims to disrupt opponent's game plan while building a strong board presence. Utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate, it aims to control the board while utilizing low-cost aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The deck also includes powerful threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to maintain a strong tempo advantage.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling a powerful combo with Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin, allowing for massive damage output and potential one-shot kills. The deck includes tools to search for and equip the hammer efficiently, protect key pieces with equipment such as Shadowspear and Giver of Runes, and generate extra mana with cards like Springleaf Drum. The inclusion of Inkmoth Nexus and Kaldra Compleat provides alternative win conditions and versatility in different matchups. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive combo strategy.

The deck focuses on using cards like Violent Outburst and Living End to quickly bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Architects of Will and Grief. The deck also includes cards like Shardless Agent and Waker of Waves to draw cards and maintain card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures like Curator of Mysteries and Troll of Khazad-dûm, while also having options like Force of Negation to protect its own game plan.

This deck focuses on fast-paced aggression using efficient creatures like Ragavan, Grief, and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt opponents while dealing damage quickly. Utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate helps control the board and clear the way for your aggro creatures. The inclusion of Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger adds a powerful finisher to close out games. The deck also includes some graveyard interaction with Undying Evil and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to give you added versatility and resilience. Overall, the key concept is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats and disruption.

This deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays through cascading into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Shardless Agent. By utilizing cascade effects like Violent Outburst and Lórien Revealed, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures and disruptive spells. The inclusion of countermagic like Mystical Dispute and Force of Negation helps protect the deck's key threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, cards like Dead / Gone and Subtlety provide additional removal and tempo plays to control the battlefield and push for victory.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and using a variety of lands to cast powerful spells with the help of Jegantha, the Wellspring. The goal is to quickly build up a board presence and deal damage to the opponent as efficiently as possible. The deck includes a mix of efficient creatures like Wild Nacatl, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Nishoba Brawler, along with versatile spells like Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt to control the game and put pressure on the opponent. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's aggressive game plan.

This deck revolves around the strategy of cycling through cards to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures, then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield. Cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will help cycle through the deck efficiently, while Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent are key pieces to casting Living End. Once the creatures are in the graveyard, the player can overwhelm the opponent with a sudden influx of powerful creatures, such as Striped Riverwinder and Grief. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Negation to protect the combo.

The deck focuses on utilizing a variety of creature cards that can be searched for and played strategically to create a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Eldritch Evolution and Chord of Calling, along with creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide, the deck aims to generate value from sacrificing and reanimating creatures, as well as dealing direct damage to the opponent. The toolbox approach allows for flexibility in adapting to different situations and finding the right creatures to win the game.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana through the use of Amulet of Vigor and Azusa, Lost but Seeking to play Primeval Titan as early as possible to search for land cards like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and The Mycosynth Gardens. The key strategy revolves around utilizing the synergy between lands and creatures to create a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent with powerful combo plays. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and Cultivator Colossus provides additional utility and win conditions to the deck.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing various powerful planeswalkers, powerful creatures, and control tools to manipulate the board state and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also aims to generate extra turns with cards like Time Warp and Omnath, Locus of Creation to gain incremental advantages and eventually overwhelm the opponent. The deck aims to secure the win by establishing a strong board presence and controlling the game tempo, making it difficult for the opponent to come back and seize control of the game.
